formal_statement: ∀ (l : ℕ) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l))), 32 ≤ l → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) π → Real.exp ((2 : ℝ) ^ l / (32768 * (l : ℝ) ^ 2)) < (π.length : ℝ)
plain_statement: For l at least 32 and n = 2^l holes, every dag-like Res(+) refutation of bit pigeonhole with n + 1 pigeons has more than exp(n / (32768 l^2)) lines (Theorem 1.1). Link of the chain to L-pcx-022 following the unrefereed arXiv:2609.23015; conjecture until checked here.
title: Dag-like Res(+) refutations of bit pigeonhole have more than exp(n / (32768 log^2 n)) lines
